accessory_addon_data.name: accessory_addon_data
accessory_addon_data.description: Used for vehicle accessories which add a visible component to a vehicle. Defines the paths to the visible models and their configuration (variant, look, excluded views), and the collision mesh path if applicable.

accessory_addon_int_data.name: accessory_addon_int_data
accessory_addon_int_data.description: The accessory_addon_int_data unit class is used for vehicle accessories which add a visible component to a vehicle with a movement simulation dependent on actual physics. This is used for customization of the player's vehicle, most commonly for some hanging parts or bobbleheads.

accessory_addon_int_ui_data.name: accessory_addon_int_ui_data
accessory_addon_int_ui_data.description:
The accessory_addon_int_ui_data unit class is used for vehicle accessories which add a visible component to a vehicle with dynamic UI screen components. This is used for customization of the player's vehicle, most commonly for additional GPS navigation screen or phones with clocks etc.

UI scripts of this accessory can access the same ID elements as dashboard or gps interior scripts, more info: https://modding.scssoft.com/wiki/Documentation/Engine/Truck_Interior_Animations_and_IDs#Dashboards_IDs

accessory_addon_tank_data.name: accessory_addon_tank_data
accessory_addon_tank_data.description: The accessory_addon_tank_data unit class is used for adding accessory based tank data container. For player trucks, units of this type are usually defined in "/def/vehicle/truck/<brand.model>/accessory/tank/*.sii" and valid unit names end in "tank".

accessory_addon_trailer_cables_data.name: accessory_addon_trailer_cables_data
accessory_addon_trailer_cables_data.description: The "accessory_addon_trailer_cables_data" unit class is used for adding dynamic trailer cables between a vehicle and its trailer. For player trucks, units of this type are usually defined in "/def/vehicle/truck/<brand.model>/accessory/trlr_cables/*.sii" and valid unit names end in ".trlr_cables". For player trailers, units of this type are usually defined in "/def/vehicle/trailer/<trailer_name>/accessory/trlr_cables/*.sii" and valid unit names end in ".trlr_cables".

accessory_cabin_data.name: accessory_cabin_data
accessory_cabin_data.description: Configures the models for the cabin of the player's vehicle. Units of this type are found in /def/vehicle/truck/<brand.model>/cabin/.

accessory_data.name: accessory_data
accessory_data.description: Superclass for all accessory_*_data classes. Defines basic UI attributes and compatibility/interaction rules between accessories. Generally not used directly — specialized subclasses are derived from it for specific accessory types.

accessory_horn_addon_data.name: accessory_horn_addon_data
accessory_horn_addon_data.description: An extension of accessory_addon_data used specifically for air horn accessories. Functions the same as accessory_addon_data, adding the sound_path attribute to bind a horn sound event to the accessory.
